from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import sys

root = Path('products/services/catalogue-google-group-id-delivery')
checker = Path('products/services/merchant-v1-group-id-sample/runnable-controls/check.py')
source = root / 'merchant-api-field-evidence.json'
evidence = json.loads(source.read_text())
runs = []
for name, expected_exit, expected_findings in [('consistent.csv', 0, []), ('conflicting.csv', 1, [['LAMP-100', 'LAMP-200']])]:
    fixture = root / 'fictional-inputs' / name
    argv = [sys.executable, str(checker), str(fixture)]
    result = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
    try:
        findings = sorted(json.loads(result.stdout)['conflicting_families'].values())
    except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
        findings = None
    runs.append({'argv': argv, 'fixture_sha256': hashlib.sha256(fixture.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'exit_code': result.returncode, 'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr, 'expected_exit_code': expected_exit, 'expected_group_id_sets': expected_findings, 'matches_expectation': result.returncode == expected_exit and findings == expected_findings})
report = {'scope': 'Fictional offline controls using supplied product-family labels. Google ingestion and buyer activity were not tested.', 'source': evidence, 'checker_sha256': hashlib.sha256(checker.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'runs': runs, 'all_pass': all(run['matches_expectation'] for run in runs)}
output = root / 'director-paired-control-run.json'
output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
print(output.read_text())
